🚀 WBT Hits New All-Time High, Up Nearly 14% From Its Previous Peak

WhiteBIT coin (WBT) reached $73, rising from its previous ATH of $64.11 in December 2025, and is currently trading at around $72. The milestone comes amid Whitechain’s relaunch as a distribution-first Ethereum Layer 2 and W Group’s continued growth to over 40 million users globally.

WBT’s full supply was unlocked in 2026, while its deflationary mechanism remains active. Regular burns, funded by 33% of WhiteBIT’s trading-fee income and 5% of income from other exchange activities, are designed to reduce the supply until 200 million WBT remain in circulation.

🇾🇪🇸🇦 BREAKING: Fires Reported at Major Saudi Energy Facilities

New reports claim fires at three locations across Saudi Arabia’s critical oil and gas infrastructure:

- Shedgum Gas Plant, Ghawar: Fire reported, with a possible Yemeni strike suspected.
- Hawiyah Gas Plant, Ghawar: Satellite imagery reportedly shows smoke rising from the facility; cause unconfirmed.
- Shaybah Oil Field: Fire reported, with no confirmed cause.

Shedgum and Hawiyah are associated with Ghawar, one of the world’s largest conventional oil fields, while Shaybah is a major Saudi oil-producing complex.
